title: सप्तविंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 127 · Duryodhana stirs Karna and the night battle

summary.en: Spurred by Drona, Duryodhana in his wrath goes to Karna and says he regrets not letting Jayadratha go home. Karna rouses him, recalling how the Pandavas were cheated, and the night battle begins with chariots and elephants entangled.
summary.kn: ದ್ರೋಣನಿಂದ ಪ್ರೇರಿತ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ಕರ್ಣನ ಬಳಿ ಹೋಗಿ ಜಯದ್ರಥನನ್ನು ಮನೆಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸದೇ ಹೋದುದಕ್ಕೆ ಪಶ್ಚಾತ್ತಾಪ ಪಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪಾಂಡವರಿಗೆ ವಂಚನೆಯಾದುದನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿ ಕರ್ಣ ಅವನನ್ನು ಪ್ರೇರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ರಥ, ಆನೆಗಳು ಬೆರೆತ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಯುದ್ಧ ಆರಂಭ.
summary.hi: द्रोण से प्रेरित क्रुद्ध दुर्योधन कर्ण के पास जाकर पछताता है कि उसने जयद्रथ को घर क्यों नहीं जाने दिया। कर्ण पाण्डवों के साथ हुए छल को याद दिलाकर उसे प्रेरित करता है, और रथों-हाथियों के उलझने के साथ रात्रियुद्ध शुरू होता है।
summary.te: ద్రోణుడు పురికొల్పగా కోపంతో దుర్యోధనుడు కర్ణుని వద్దకు వెళ్లి జయద్రథుని ఇంటికి పంపనందుకు చింతిస్తాడు. పాండవులకు జరిగిన మోసాన్ని గుర్తు చేసి కర్ణుడు అతన్ని ప్రేరేపిస్తాడు; రథాలు, ఏనుగులు కలిసిపోయిన రాత్రి యుద్ధం మొదలవుతుంది.
summary.ta: த்ரோணரால் தூண்டப்பட்ட துரியோதனன் சினத்துடன் கர்ணனிடம் சென்று ஜயத்ரதனை வீட்டுக்கு அனுப்பாததற்கு வருந்துகிறான். பாண்டவர் ஏமாற்றப்பட்டதை நினைவூட்டி கர்ணன் அவனைத் தூண்ட, தேர்களும் யானைகளும் பின்னிய இரவுப்போர் தொடங்குகிறது.
summary.ml: ദ്രോണരുടെ പ്രേരണയാൽ കോപാകുലനായ ദുര്യോധനൻ കർണ്ണന്റെ അടുത്തെത്തി, ജയദ്രഥനെ വീട്ടിലേക്ക് പോകാൻ അനുവദിക്കാഞ്ഞത് ഖേദകരമാണെന്ന് പറയുന്നു. പാണ്ഡവർ വഞ്ചിക്കപ്പെട്ടത് ഓർമിപ്പിച്ച് കർണ്ണൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ഉണർത്തുന്നു; രഥങ്ങളും ആനകളും കുടുങ്ങിക്കിടക്കുന്ന രാത്രിയുദ്ധം തുടങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.127; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा द्रोणेनैवं प्रचोदितः ।
अमर्षवशमापन्नो युद्धायैव मनो दधे ॥

meaning.en: Then King Duryodhana, spurred on by Drona like this, fell under the sway of anger and set his mind on fighting.

verses.text:
अब्रवीच्च तदा कर्णं पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव ।
पश्य कृष्णसहायेन पाण्डवेन किरीटिना ।
आचार्यविहितं व्यूहं भिन्नं देवैः सुदुर्भिदम् ॥

meaning.en: Your son Duryodhana then said to Karna: "See how the Pandava Kiritin, with Krishna as his helper, has broken the formation arranged by the teacher, though even the gods could hardly break it.

verses.text:
तव व्यायच्छमानस्य द्रोणस्य च महात्मनः ।
मिषतां योधमुख्यानां सैन्धवो विनिपातितः ॥

meaning.en: While you and great-souled Drona were striving, Saindhava was struck down before the eyes of the foremost warriors.

verses.text:
पश्य राधेय राजानः पृथिव्यां प्रवरा युधि ।
पार्थेनैकेन निहताः सिंहेनेवेतरा मृगाः ॥

meaning.en: Look, Radheya: the best kings on earth have been killed in battle by Partha alone, as a lion kills other beasts.

verses.text:
मम व्यायच्छमानस्य समरे शत्रुसूदन ।
अल्पावशेषं सैन्यं मे कृतं शक्रात्मजेन ह ॥

meaning.en: While I was striving in battle, slayer of enemies, Indra's son has left my army with little remaining.

verses.text:
कथं ह्यनिच्छमानस्य द्रोणस्य युधि फल्गुनः ।
भिन्द्यात्सुदुर्भिदं व्यूहं यतमानोऽपि संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: How could Phalguna, against Drona's wish, break that hard-to-break formation, however he tried in battle?

verses.text:
प्रियो हि फल्गुनो नित्यमाचार्यस्य महात्मनः ।
ततोऽस्य दत्तवान्द्वारं नयुद्धेनारिमर्दन ॥

meaning.en: Phalguna is always dear to the great-souled teacher, so Drona gave him the entrance, not through fighting, O crusher of foes.

verses.text:
अभयं सैन्धवस्याजौ दत्त्वा द्रोणः परंतपः ।
प्रादात्किरीटिने द्वारं पश्य निर्गुणतां मम ॥

meaning.en: Giving Saindhava safety in battle, tormentor of foes Drona gave Kiritin the way in. See my lack of luck.

verses.text:
यद्यदास्यमनुज्ञां वै पूर्वमेव गृहान्प्रति ।
सिन्धुराजस्य समरे नाभविष्यज्जनक्षयः ॥

meaning.en: If he had given Saindhava leave earlier to go home, there would have been no slaughter of men in battle.

verses.text:
जयद्रथो जीवितार्थी गच्छमानो गृहान्प्रति ।
मयानार्येण संरुद्धो द्रोणात्प्राप्याभयं रणे ॥

meaning.en: Jayadratha, wanting to save his life and going home, was stopped by me, base as I am, after getting a promise of safety from Drona in the battle.

verses.text:
अद्य मे भ्रातरः क्षीणाश्चित्रसेनादयो युधि ।
भीमसेनं समासाद्य पश्यतां नो दुरात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Today my brothers, led by Chitrasena, have been destroyed in the fight, having come up against Bhimasena, as we, wicked ones, looked on."

verses.text: कर्ण उवाच

meaning.en: Karna said:

verses.text:
आचार्यं मा विगर्हस्व शक्त्या युध्यत्यसौ द्विजः ।
अजय्यान्पाण्डवान्मन्ये द्रोणेनास्त्रविदा मृधे ॥

meaning.en: Do not blame the teacher; that Brahmin fights with all his strength. I think the Pandavas cannot be conquered by Drona, expert in weapons, in battle.

verses.text:
तथा ह्येनमतिक्रम्य प्रविष्टः श्वेतवाहनः ।
दैवदृष्टोऽन्यथाभावो न मन्ये विद्यते क्वचित् ॥

meaning.en: For the white-horsed one passed him and entered. I do not think any change in what fate has shown is ever possible.

verses.text:
ततो नो युध्यमानानां परं शक्त्या सुयोधन ।
सैन्धवो निहतो राजन्दैवमत्र परं स्मृतम् ॥

meaning.en: So when we fought with all our power, Suyodhana, Saindhava was killed, king; fate is held supreme here.

verses.text:
परं यत्नं कुर्वतां च त्वया सार्धं रणाजिरे ।
हत्वास्माकं पौरुषं हि दैवं पश्चात्करोति नः ।
सततं चेष्टमानानां निकृत्या विक्रमेण च ॥

meaning.en: Striving our utmost alongside you on the battlefield, fate afterwards destroys our manliness, as we constantly strive with stratagem and valor.

verses.text:
दैवोपसृष्टः पुरुषो यत्कर्म कुरुते क्वचित् ।
कृतं कृतं स्म तत्तस्य दैवेन विनिहन्यते ॥

meaning.en: A man touched by fate who does some deed anywhere sees each thing he does destroyed by fate.

verses.text:
यत्कर्तव्यं मनुष्येण व्यवसायवता सता ।
तत्कार्यमविशङ्केन सिद्धिर्दैवे प्रतिष्ठिता ॥

meaning.en: What a man of firm resolve should do, being good, he must do without hesitation; success rests with fate.

verses.text:
निकृत्या निकृताः पार्था विषयोगैश्च भारत ।
दग्धा जतुगृहे चापि द्यूतेन च पराजिताः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas were cheated by trickery and poison, Bharata, burned in the lacquer house and beaten at dice.

verses.text:
राजनीतिं व्यपाश्रित्य प्रहिताश्चैव काननम् ।
यत्नेन च कृतं यत्ते दैवेन विनिपातितम् ॥

meaning.en: Following royal policy you sent them to the forest, and what you did with effort was struck down by fate.

verses.text:
युध्यस्व यत्नमास्थाय मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम् ।
यततस्तव तेषां च दैवं मार्गेण यास्यति ॥

meaning.en: Fight with effort, making death your turning-back; as you and they strive, fate will go its way.

verses.text:
न तेषां मतिपूर्वं हि सुकृतं दृश्यते क्वचित् ।
दुष्कृतं तव वा वीर बुद्ध्या हीनं कुरूद्वह ॥

meaning.en: No good deed of theirs is seen, anywhere, done with deliberate intention; nor is any bad deed of yours, hero, descendant of Kuru, done from lack of understanding.

verses.text:
दैवं प्रमाणं सर्वस्य सुकृतस्येतरस्य वा ।
अनन्यकर्म दैवं हि जागर्ति स्वपतामपि ॥

meaning.en: Fate is the measure of everything, of good deeds and the other kind; fate, whose work is unlike any other, stays awake even while men sleep.

verses.text:
बहूनि तव सैन्यानि योधाश्च बहवस्तथा ।
न तथा पाण्डुपुत्राणामेवं युद्धमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: Your armies are many and your warriors many, but the Pandavas' war did not go like that.

verses.text:
तैरल्पैर्बहवो यूयं क्षयं नीताः प्रहारिणः ।
शङ्के दैवस्य तत्कर्म पौरुषं येन नाशितम् ॥

meaning.en: Yet by those few, you many, though strikers, were brought to ruin. I suspect that was the work of fate, by which manly effort was destroyed."

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
एवं संभाषमाणानां बहु तत्तज्जनाधिप ।
पाण्डवानामनीकानि समदृश्यन्त संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: While they spoke thus, many things, O lord of men, the Pandava armies appeared in the battle.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं व्यतिषक्तरथद्विपम् ।
तावकानां परैः सार्धं राजन्दुर्मन्त्रिते तव ॥

meaning.en: Then the fight began, with chariots and elephants entangled, between your men and the enemy, O king, from your ill counsel.
